when: everyone in bot lane is level 1 and the first wave has not died yet
asks: do I push level one
should we shove the first wave
push or chill at the start
do I hit the wave right away
say: Hit the wave with your support to reach level 2 first, or last-hit only and let it come if their lane out-fights yours early.
more: Level 2 arrives partway through the second wave, and whoever gets there first has an extra ability and stats for a few seconds. That is the first real fight window of the lane.
Pushing has a price: the wave ends up near their tower, which is the long, exposed side of the lane once their jungler finishes a first clear.
If you let it come instead, you give up the early fight but farm close to your tower for the next couple of minutes.
check: Whether their duo is hitting the wave too, and whether your support is actually helping you push.
breaks: If their lane is clearly stronger at level 1 and already pushing, do not contest it. Last-hit from range and take the wave at your tower.

when: your support is an engage champion such as Leona, Nautilus, Alistar or Rakan and everyone in bot lane is level 1
asks: we have engage do we push for two
should I race level two
do we go for level two
is this a level two lane
say: Shove hard now so your support gets a level 2 engage, or just hold the wave even if they are matching your push.
more: An engage support with two abilities against a lane that still has one each is the classic early kill or Flash. It only exists if you level first.
Even without a kill, a forced Flash this early makes the next engage a few minutes later much more dangerous for them.
If they match the push, the race is a coin flip and you end up pushed out for nothing, so settle for an even wave.
check: Which side's minions are dying faster, and whether your support is standing forward ready to go.
breaks: If they reach level 2 first, the same window belongs to them. Drop back behind your casters until you level.
basis: pro:Early on, a level is worth more than a little gold

when: an enemy bot laner is level 2 and you are level 1
asks: they got level two first what now
they hit two before us
do I back off
they're level two am I in danger
say: Step back behind your minions until you level, even if it costs a couple of last hits, or hold ground only if their support cannot engage.
more: A level is extra stats plus an ability. For the few seconds they have it and you do not, any fight is theirs.
Two missed minions is a small price. Getting chunked or losing Flash here decides the next several minutes of lane.
Once you level too, the lane is even again and you can walk back up.
check: How close their support is standing to you, and whether they are walking forward together.
breaks: If their support has no way to start a fight on you, the danger is small. Keep last-hitting, just do not step past your minions.
basis: pro:Early on, a level is worth more than a little gold

when: you have more kills and more CS than their marksman
asks: I'm ahead what do I do with the wave
should I freeze
do I freeze or push when I'm winning
how do I deny them
say: Hold the wave just outside your tower so they have to walk up to farm, or shove it in and recall if your gold buys something.
more: A wave held on your side makes every last hit a risk for them: a long walk back and your jungler behind them.
Freezing denies gold slowly. Shoving and buying turns the lead into an item now. Pick the freeze when you have nothing to buy.
A long freeze also keeps you safe from ganks while their marksman falls further behind.
check: Where the wave actually sits, and whether more enemy minions than yours are arriving so it stays put.
breaks: If a dragon is about to spawn or their jungler is on the other side, a freeze wastes the lead. Shove and move, or shove and hit the tower.

when: their marksman is ahead of you in level or kills
asks: I'm behind how do I farm
what do I do with the wave when losing
they're stronger where do I keep the wave
I'm losing lane help
say: Let the wave push to you and farm near your tower, or thin it from range if it gets big enough to dive behind.
more: Near your tower their lead is hard to use: they have to step under it or stand in a long lane to reach you.
The danger is a very large wave. That is what a dive is built on, so trim it with abilities before it stacks.
A few quiet minutes of farm is how the gap closes. You do not need a kill to get back in.
check: How big the incoming wave is, and whether their jungler has shown anywhere recently.
breaks: If they freeze the wave on their side instead of pushing, this does not work. Ask for help to break it or soak experience from range.

when: their marksman is dead and their support is alive
asks: their adc is dead do I push
he died what do I do with the wave
enemy carry dead should I shove
push or freeze he's dead
say: Shove everything into their tower so the minions die to it, or freeze near yours instead if their support alone can't break it.
more: Minions that die to the tower are gold and experience he never gets. That is how a kill becomes a real lead.
A freeze near your tower costs him even more when he walks back, but only works if the wave is already on your side.
Shoving also frees you to recall or hit the tower before he returns.
check: Where the wave is right now, and how long his respawn timer has left.
breaks: If the wave is far from their tower and his timer is short, you will not crash it in time. Hold it on your side instead.
basis: pro:Kills are not a lead if the farm went the other way

when: both enemy bot laners are dead
asks: they're both dead what now
double kill do I push
do I take plates or back
both dead should I recall
say: Crash the wave and hit the tower for plates while both are dead, or crash and recall now if you're low or holding real gold.
more: With nobody defending, the wave carries you to the tower for free. Plates are gold you can only get in the lane phase.
The crash matters either way: they come back to a wave lost under their tower.
If you are low, their jungler arriving turns a won lane into a shutdown, so take the safe recall.
check: Their respawn timers, your own health, and whether their jungler was seen far away.
breaks: If their jungler or mid is walking down, leave the tower. Crash the wave and go.
basis: pro:After a won fight, the waves decide whether you got paid

when: your support is dead and both enemy bot laners are alive
asks: my support died what do I do
support's dead do I stay
I'm alone can I farm
supp died should I back off
say: Back up to your tower and take only the last hits that come to you, or leave the wave if both walk past it.
more: One against two, every step forward is a fight you cannot win. The wave is worth less than your life and Flash.
If they push in and stand in front of your tower, they are setting up a dive. Leaving costs a wave; staying can cost the wave and a kill.
check: How big their wave is, and whether a third enemy is coming through the river or behind your tower.
breaks: If your jungler is right there and they overstep under tower, you can turn it. Otherwise give the wave.
basis: pro:The lane without help gives nothing

asks: how do I farm under tower
I keep missing cs at tower
wave's stuck under my turret
they keep shoving me in
say: Last-hit under the tower and keep your health up, or clear the wave quickly with abilities if a recall is waiting.
more: Being pushed in is not losing. You are safe from ganks and they are exposed, as long as you keep collecting the minions.
Missed last hits under tower are the real cost, so stop trading and concentrate on timing your attacks with the tower shots.
A wave that fully dies at your tower lets the next one meet further out, and that is your moment to step up or recall.
check: Whether they are standing in front of your tower with a growing wave behind them.
breaks: If they stack a second big wave and a third enemy appears, this is a dive setup. Clear the minions first or leave.

when: your gold covers a component and both enemy bot laners are alive
asks: how do I set up a recall
I want to back how do I do it
how do I recall without losing cs
I have gold when do I go
say: Kill the casters first so a big wave builds, crash it into their tower, then recall, or just back now if you're too low to stay.
more: A wave that crashes into their tower takes time to die, and that time covers your walk back. You lose almost nothing.
Recalling on a wave that is in the middle hands them a free push into your tower and the minions with it.
Returning with an item while they are still on old gear is your next trading window.
check: Whether your wave is really bigger than theirs, and whether it will reach their tower before you leave.
breaks: If they are freezing or you cannot push without taking heavy damage, do not force the crash. Recall and accept the lost minions.

when: a dragon is up or spawns within about a minute
asks: dragon's coming what do I do with the wave
should I push before drake
do I shove for dragon
drake soon do I stay bot
say: Push the wave in before the dragon so you can walk over first, or stay and farm if your jungler isn't going for it.
more: Whoever pushes first gets to the river first, with their support, and the other duo has to choose between minions and the fight.
Arriving second means walking into brush they already hold.
If nobody on your team is going, moving just costs you a wave, so keep farming.
check: Whether your jungler is heading to the dragon, and whether your wave will actually reach their tower in time.
breaks: If their lane has already shoved you in, you cannot move first. Tell your jungler and keep the wave rather than walking in late.
basis: pro:The lane that pushes first moves first

when: a kill or objective event on the top side involved their jungler in the last 20 seconds
asks: their jungler's top can I push
jungler showed top what do I do
is it safe to go up now
enemy jungle is top side
say: Their jungler is top side, so push up and trade for a short while, or just take plates if the fight isn't there.
more: A jungler who just showed far away cannot punish a long lane for the time it takes him to walk back.
Use it for whatever was too risky before: a deep ward, a hard shove, a trade past the middle of the lane.
The window closes fast. Once he drops out of sight again, go back to playing as if he could be near.
check: That it really was their jungler who showed, and whether their mid is missing instead.
breaks: If their mid laner is missing or has Teleport-style ways to arrive, the lane is not as free as it looks. Push, but stop at the river line.
basis: pro:A jungler seen on the far side opens yours

when: their jungler has not appeared in any kill or objective event for about two minutes
asks: where's their jungler
is it safe to push
haven't seen their jungle
can I keep pushing
say: Nobody has seen their jungler, so pull the wave back toward your side, or keep pushing only if the river is warded.
more: A jungler who is not where his route should put him is usually on his way to a lane, and the pushed lane is the easy one.
Backing off costs a few minions. Getting caught past the middle costs the wave, a death and often the tower plates.
Your own jungler being nearby does not tell you where theirs is.
check: Whether the river and tri-brush are warded, and when someone last saw him on the map.
breaks: If a ward shows him on the far side, the warning is off for a short while and you can step back up.
basis: pro:A jungler missing from where he should be is information

asks: how do I use my wave clear
should I be shoving as Sivir
do I spam Q on the wave
push or hold as Sivir
say: Use Ricochet and Boomerang Blade to shove every wave and move first, or hold the wave and save mana if their lane wants to all-in.
more: Sivir's bouncing attacks clear waves faster than most marksmen, so she can decide where the wave is.
Constant push means first move to dragon and free tower damage, and it denies them time to set up trades.
The cost is a long lane. Keep Spell Shield for the ability that starts their engage.
check: Your mana, and whether their jungler has shown recently.
breaks: If their jungler is unseen and you are past the middle, stop shoving. A fast clear does not help when you are caught.

asks: how do I lane as Cait
should I push as Caitlyn
where do I put traps
do I shove them under tower
say: Push them under tower and trap where they stand to last-hit, or keep the wave mid-lane if their jungler hasn't shown anywhere.
more: Caitlyn is strongest when the enemy must farm under tower: every last hit there is a free auto, and a sprung trap gives an empowered Headshot.
That pressure turns into plates and often the first tower, which opens the map for your team.
The risk is the long lane behind you, so the push needs vision or a known jungler.
check: Whether the river brush is warded, and how many traps you have down behind you.
breaks: If you are behind or they have hard engage ready, pushing just puts you in range. Farm from max range near the middle instead.

asks: I'm a late game champ where do I keep the wave
do I push as a scaling adc
should I just farm
how do I get to late game
say: Keep the wave on your half and farm; you win later, not now, or push only when one of them is dead or recalled.
more: A scaling marksman gains more from ten quiet minutes than from an even fight now. Farm near your tower is the safest farm there is.
Each completed item moves the lane toward you, so the plan is to arrive at your items without giving kills.
Pushing is fine when it is free: a dead or recalled opponent cannot punish it.
check: Whether the wave is being held on your side or dragged out by your own attacks.
breaks: If they roam and take objectives while you sit back, pure farming loses the map. Shove and follow, or hit the tower.

when: their marksman's items just changed and yours have not
asks: they backed do I push
enemy adc recalled what now
he just bought should I stay
they went base do I shove
say: Shove the wave into their tower before they walk back, then recall too, or freeze it near yours if you can't crash in time.
more: A wave that dies to their tower while they are away is gold they lose. It also lets you recall and come back even on items.
If you stay out on old items against a fresh buy, the next trade is theirs.
A freeze works if the wave is already on your side: they return to a wave they have to walk a long way for.
check: Whether they are already back in lane, and how far your wave is from their tower.
breaks: If they are already walking into lane with the new item, stop pushing. Back off and look for your own recall on the next wave.

asks: I can't walk up how do I farm
they're zoning me off the wave
how do I cs when I can't get close
I'm getting zoned
say: Farm with Mystic Shot from behind your minions and keep Arcane Shift for their engage, or walk up only once their key ability is used.
more: Mystic Shot lets Ezreal collect minions from a distance other marksmen cannot, so being zoned costs him less.
Each Mystic Shot that hits also shortens his cooldowns, so farming with it keeps Arcane Shift coming back.
You give up push this way, which means their duo moves first to the river.
check: Your mana, and whether their engage ability has been used.
breaks: If you are low on mana, you cannot farm with abilities for long. Take only tower minions and plan a recall.

asks: my jungler's coming bot how do I set it up
gank coming should I push
jungle is pathing bot what do I do with the wave
how do I help my jungler gank
say: Stop pushing and let the wave drift to your side so they're far from tower, or shove and dive only with a big wave.
more: A gank works when they have a long way to run. A wave near your tower gives your jungler that distance.
Looking weak helps too: stay healthy enough to fight but do not scare them back before he arrives.
A dive is the other option, and it needs a large wave to take the tower shots plus their escapes already used.
check: Where your jungler actually is, and whether they have a ward in the river or tri-brush.
breaks: If the wave is already under their tower and small, the gank has no room. Tell your jungler and reset the wave first.

asks: I crashed the wave what happens now
wave's coming back at me
do I keep pushing after it hits tower
what does the wave do after I shove
say: After a crash the next wave pushes back to you, so drop back and farm it, or recall now and meet it at your tower.
more: When your wave dies at their tower, their next minions arrive with nothing to fight and walk toward you.
That returning wave is safe farm on your side and a good place to hold the lane for a while.
Following it up the lane instead keeps you extended for no gain.
check: Whether the whole wave actually reached their tower, or part of it died in the middle.
breaks: If a dragon or plate is on offer and their duo is gone, staying forward is fine. Otherwise do not chase the push.

when: their marksman is ahead of you in CS and kills
asks: they're freezing on me what do I do
I can't get to the wave
wave's stuck on their side
how do I break a freeze
say: Don't walk up alone into a freeze; ask your support or jungler to help break it, or soak experience from range until it moves.
more: A freeze is held by a duo that wins the fight. Walking in to last-hit is exactly what they want.
A third player pushing the wave into their tower resets it, and often gets a kill because they are standing far up.
Losing gold for a minute hurts less than dying and losing the experience as well.
check: Whether the wave is really being held or is slowly pushing to you, and where your jungler is.
breaks: If the wave is creeping toward your tower on its own, just wait. It will arrive and you can farm safely.

asks: how do I stack fast
how do I farm as Smolder
should I fight or stack
stacks or cs
say: Last-hit with Super Scorcher Breath for stacks and let the wave come to you, or tag them with abilities when they step up.
more: Smolder's stacks come from kills with Super Scorcher Breath and from ability hits on champions, and they make his basic abilities stronger for the rest of the game.
A wave near your tower gives you time to line up each last hit with the ability instead of rushing.
Poking them with abilities when it is free adds stacks without risking a real trade.
check: Your mana, and whether stepping up for an ability hit puts you in their engage range.
breaks: If chasing stacks is costing you health against a lane that can all-in, stop poking and take stacks only from minions.

asks: when do I trade
when can I hit them
is it safe to trade
when should I go for autos
say: Trade right after their support uses their main ability, then step back out, or just farm while it's still up.
more: Bot lane trades are decided by the supports' key abilities. While theirs is on cooldown they cannot punish you for stepping up.
Short trades in those windows add up to a health lead, and a health lead is what lets you push and recall on your terms.
check: Whether you actually saw the hook, stun or poke ability used, and that your own support is close enough to help.
breaks: If your support is far back or low, even a good window is one against two. Take the last hit and skip the trade.

when: their support is Thresh, Blitzcrank, Nautilus or Pyke
asks: how do I play against the hook
when can I trade into hook supports
I keep getting hooked
what do I do versus Blitz
say: Keep minions between you and the hook; when it misses, walk up and hit them, or stay back if your wave is thin.
more: A hook has to travel to you, so a line of minions in the way is your shield. Their whole lane is built around that one ability.
A missed hook is the longest safe window you get. Use it to trade or to shove the wave.
When your wave is nearly dead there is nothing to hide behind, so that is when you give ground.
check: Where their support is standing relative to your minions, and whether the hook was just thrown.
breaks: If they are in a side brush with a clear line to you, minions do not help. Move so the wave is between you again or back off.

when: you and your support are level 2 and both enemy bot laners are level 1
asks: we got level two do we fight
we hit two first
should I go in now
level two do I trade
say: You're level 2 first, so walk at them and fight now, or just zone them off the wave if your support hangs back.
more: For a few seconds you have an extra ability each. That is the biggest relative lead you will have before items.
A kill is good, a burned Flash is nearly as good, and even just pushing them off the wave costs them minions and delays their level.
Do it immediately. Once they level, the window is gone.
check: Whether your support is moving forward with you, and where their jungler could be this early.
breaks: If your support is not following, do not go alone. Stand forward and deny the wave instead.
basis: pro:Early on, a level is worth more than a little gold

when: you are level 6 and their marksman is level 5
asks: I hit six first do I fight
I'm six they're not
should I all in at six
I have ult do I go
say: You have your ultimate and they don't, so look for the fight this wave, or use it to shove and recall instead.
more: An ultimate against no ultimate is the clearest lead in the lane phase, and it lasts only until they level.
If the fight is not there, the level still helps: shove with it, recall, and come back with an item as well.
check: Whether both supports are 6 too, and your health compared with theirs.
breaks: If their support is already 6 and yours is not, the lead is smaller than it looks. Poke first and fight only if they are low.
basis: pro:Early on, a level is worth more than a little gold

when: their marksman is level 6 and you are level 5
asks: they're six and I'm not
they hit six first
can I still trade
do I respect their ult
say: They hit 6 first, so no trades until you level, or fight only if you saw their ultimate used.
more: They are looking for exactly this fight. Stay where they cannot start it and the window passes with nothing lost.
Farm toward your own level 6 and the lane is even again.
check: Whether their ultimate was already used, and how close you are to leveling.
breaks: If their ultimate was just spent on something else, the level gap matters much less and you can trade normally.
basis: pro:Early on, a level is worth more than a little gold

when: their support is dead and their marksman is alive
asks: their support's dead do we fight
it's a two v one right
support died can I go on the adc
their supp is gone
say: Their marksman is alone, so walk up together and force him off the wave, or shove for plates if he just hugs tower.
more: Two against one, he cannot trade back, so every last hit he tries costs him health.
If he gives up the wave, take the gold on offer: minions he misses, then plates.
check: That their support is really dead or far away and not standing in a brush, and the respawn timer.
breaks: If their jungler comes to cover, the numbers are even again. Step back to the middle of the lane.

asks: why do I lose trades when I hit them
minions are killing me
should I fight in their wave
why did that trade go so bad
say: Trade when your wave is bigger than theirs, since minions hit back hard early, or wait a wave if theirs is the big one.
more: When you attack a champion, nearby enemy minions turn on you. Early on that damage is a large share of a trade.
So the same trade is good inside your wave and bad inside theirs. Count minions before you step up.
check: How many minions each side has near the fight, especially casters.
breaks: If you can hit them from outside their minions' reach, or step into a brush right after, the wave size matters much less.

when: an enemy bot laner has Ignite and neither you nor your support has Ignite or Exhaust
asks: they have ignite
can I fight them early
who wins the all in
they took ignite do I respect it
say: They brought Ignite and you didn't, so keep trades short and stay healthy, or fight only when a jungler is with you.
more: Ignite is extra damage in a fight to the death and it cuts healing, so long early fights lean their way.
Short trades avoid it. They cannot use Ignite well on a target who walks away at high health.
Your defensive spells pay off later, in fights where you survive the first burst.
check: Whether Ignite was used recently, since you cannot see its cooldown.
breaks: If you saw Ignite used on someone, the edge is gone for a few minutes and an all-in is back on the table.

when: their marksman has more items than you
asks: they have more items
he bought and I didn't
can I fight after they backed
they just got an item
say: They've bought and you haven't, so skip trades until you recall, or trade only if you're a level up.
more: Unspent gold does nothing in a fight. Until you recall, you are playing against the item you could have had.
A level can offset a small item gap early, which is the one case where the trade is still reasonable.
check: What they actually bought, and how much gold you are holding.
breaks: If they bought only boots or a ward item, the gap is small. Trade as normal.
basis: pro:Skipping the recall keeps camp pace but not power

when: you have more items than their marksman
asks: I just bought can I fight
I have an item they don't
I'm back with items do I go in
am I stronger now
say: You have the item edge until they recall, so push up and trade now, or take plates if they won't fight.
more: An item lead is temporary. It ends the moment they get to base, so it has to be used in the next wave or two.
If they refuse to trade, they are giving you the wave and the tower. Take that instead of forcing a dive.
check: Whether they are about to recall, and where their jungler was last seen.
breaks: If their support out-levels yours or their jungler is close, the item alone does not carry the fight. Push and hit the tower.
basis: pro:A lead is not power until it is spent

asks: how do I trade as Draven
when do I go in with axes
should I catch every axe
how do I lane Draven
say: Trade with a Spinning Axe ready and step toward the catch spot early, or drop the axe if catching it walks you into their engage.
more: A Spinning Axe adds damage to the attack, and catching it readies the next one and refreshes Blood Rush, so each catch keeps the trade going.
Opponents aim abilities at the landing spot. An axe is never worth a hook or a stun.
Kills pay Draven extra through Adoration, so a healthy Draven with axes spinning is the lane's biggest threat.
check: Where the axe is going to land compared with where their support is standing.
breaks: If you are behind and they have engage ready, stop trading. Catch only the axes that land on your side of the wave.

asks: how do I trade as Lucian
when do I dash in
what's my combo in lane
how do I use Lucian passive
say: Dash in with Relentless Pursuit, ability then double-shot, and back out, or hold the dash if their engage is still up.
more: Every ability Lucian uses makes his next attack a double-shot, so a trade is ability, attack, ability, attack, then leave.
A heal or shield from your support, or an enemy being immobilized, adds bonus damage to his next two attacks. Trade when your support is with you.
The dash is also his only escape, so using it forward is a commitment.
check: Whether their crowd control has been used, and that your support is in range to shield or follow.
breaks: If the dash is down and they engage, you have nothing. Without it, stay at max range and farm.

asks: how do I trade as Caitlyn
how do I use my range
when do I auto them
how do I bully as Cait
say: Auto them each time they step up to last-hit and keep 90 Caliber Net to escape, or ease off while their wave is bigger.
more: They have to stand still to last-hit, and that is when a long-range attack is free.
Headshot adds damage every few attacks, so try to have it ready for a champion rather than a minion.
The net pushes Caitlyn backward, so it is her way out of an engage. Using it to poke leaves her with none.
check: Whether Headshot is ready, and how many enemy minions will turn on you.
breaks: If their support has a long-range engage ready, max-range autos still put you in reach. Wait until it is used.

asks: how do I trade as Vayne
can I fight early as Vayne
should I go for three hits
when do I tumble in
say: Take short trades of three hits for Silver Bolts and Tumble out, or just farm; your lane is about reaching items.
more: The third hit on one target is where Vayne's damage is. Two hits and a retreat is mostly wasted.
Tumble is both the trade tool and the escape. Tumbling forward against a lane with crowd control leaves nothing to leave with.
Condemn stuns only if it knocks them into terrain, so near a wall it is a fight starter and in open lane it is a peel tool.
check: Whether their crowd control is down, and whether a wall is behind them.
breaks: Against a long-range lane you may never reach three hits. Then give up trading and take what farm you can.

asks: when do I jump in as Tristana
should I rocket jump on them
how do I all in as Trist
is it safe to jump
say: Rocket Jump in only when they're low enough to finish, or stay at range and trade autos while their crowd control is up.
more: Rocket Jump is Tristana's engage and her escape. Jumping forward into two healthy champions leaves her stuck there.
Rapid Fire makes a short burst of attacks much stronger, so start trades with it rather than with the jump.
At level 6 Buster Shot knocks a target away, which can finish a kill or push off whoever dives her.
check: Their health, and whether the ability that would lock you down has been used.
breaks: If their jungler is unseen, a forward jump is a gift. Keep it and trade from range.

asks: how do I poke as MF
how do I land Q on them
what's the Miss Fortune trade
how do I use Double Up
say: Line up Double Up through a dying minion so it bounces onto them, or switch targets between autos for the Love Tap damage.
more: Double Up hits a target and then one behind it, so a minion in front of them is your way to reach them safely.
Love Tap adds damage each time she attacks a new target, so alternating between a minion and a champion makes each hit stronger.
Strut gives her speed while she is not being hit, so taking poke slows her down as well.
check: Whether an enemy champion is lined up behind a minion you can hit.
breaks: If they stand to the side of the wave, the bounce is not there. Use autos and Make It Rain instead of forcing it.

when: your support is an engage champion such as Leona, Nautilus, Alistar or Rakan
asks: when do I go in as Kai'Sa
how do I trade as Kaisa
do I follow my support
how do I proc my passive
say: Go in when your support lands crowd control; it helps stack your Plasma fast, or poke with Void Seeker if they stay back.

say: Jinx has no dash, so jump her when Flame Chompers is down, or just deny the kill that speeds her up.
more: Her only defence is Flame Chompers, a line of traps that take a moment to arm. Once it is used she cannot escape.
She gains a big burst of speed whenever she helps kill a champion or destroy a tower. Do not give her the first one.
She scales hard, so an early lead matters more here than in most lanes.
check: Whether Flame Chompers was just used, and where her support is.
breaks: If you cannot reach her past her support, do not force it. Keep the lane even and avoid dying.

when: their marksman is Tristana
asks: how do I lane against Tristana
Trist keeps jumping on me
what do I do versus Tristana
can I fight Tristana
say: Stay healthy so Rocket Jump isn't a kill, and fight her after she jumps in, or just farm until she wastes it.
more: Rocket Jump is how she starts and how she leaves. If she jumps on you and nobody dies, she is stuck in your lane.
Rapid Fire makes her attacks very fast for a short time. Back off during it and return when it ends.
At level 6 Buster Shot knocks a target away, so she can push your support off her or finish a kill.
check: Your health against what she can do in one jump, and whether Rocket Jump was used.
breaks: If you are low, she does not need the jump to be safe. Recall instead of testing it.

when: an enemy bot laner is Ziggs
asks: how do I lane against Ziggs
they have a mage bot
Ziggs keeps shoving me
what do I do versus Ziggs
say: Ziggs out-pushes you from range, so farm under tower and dodge, or all-in him when Satchel Charge is used.
more: His bombs clear waves from far away, so you will be at your tower a lot. Focus on last hits there.
Satchel Charge knocks enemies away and moves him too. It is his escape, and without it he is fragile.
His mines slow, so do not chase through them.
check: Whether Satchel Charge was used, and where the mines are.
breaks: If you cannot reach him even without Satchel Charge, ask for a gank. A pushed mage is a long way from his tower.

when: their support is Pyke and he is level 6
asks: Pyke is six
how do I play against Pyke
Pyke keeps executing me
what do I do versus Pyke now
say: Pyke can execute low targets now, so recall earlier than usual, or stay only while your health is high.
more: Death From Below kills targets under a health threshold outright, and can be used again after it does. Low health in lane is no longer safe.
He heals back recent champion damage while hidden, so chip damage on him does not stick.
His gold from the ultimate is shared with an assisting ally, so each execute feeds two players.
check: Your health and your support's, and whether Pyke is out of sight.
breaks: If he is missing from lane, he has probably gone mid. Tell your team and push while he is away.

when: their marksman is Lucian
asks: how do I lane against Lucian
Lucian keeps bursting me
what do I do versus Lucian
can I trade with Lucian
say: Lucian wins short bursts, so stay past his dash range and farm, or trade back right after he dashes in.
more: His pattern is dash, ability, double-shot, and out. It is strong for a moment and then mostly on cooldown.
Relentless Pursuit is a short dash. If he used it to come forward, he has to walk back.
He is strongest early and with a support who heals, shields or immobilizes. Later his short range becomes a problem for him.
check: Whether he just used his dash, and his distance from you.
breaks: If he and his support are both stepping forward together, do not trade back. Give the wave.

when: their marksman is Twitch
asks: how do I lane against Twitch
Twitch went invisible
what do I do versus Twitch
where did Twitch go
say: When Twitch disappears, step back toward your tower until he shows, or stay beside your support so his opener gets punished.
more: Ambush hides him and gives attack speed when he reappears. He wants to start on you from an angle you are not watching.
He is weak in a straight early fight and has no dash, so when you can see him, the lane is yours to push.
If he has been gone a while, he may be walking to mid. Say so.
check: Whether he is visible, and how long he has been gone.
breaks: If he is out of lane entirely, shove the wave and take plates. He loses minions for every second he roams.

when: you are at lower level than their bot laners and their jungler is alive
asks: are they gonna dive me
should I leave tower
they're stacking a big wave
do I stay under tower
say: If a big wave is coming with three of them, leave the tower and lose the wave, or stay and clear minions if help is close.
more: A dive needs minions to take the tower shots. Remove the wave and the tower hits the divers instead.
If you cannot clear it in time, the wave is already lost. Staying only adds your death to it.
Help arriving changes it: a dive that runs into a second defender often gives kills back.
check: How many enemies are near, how big the wave is, and whether your jungler or mid is coming.
breaks: If only two of them are there and you have Flash and your support, you can hold. Stay behind the tower and last-hit.
basis: pro:A dive runs on minions and one defensive button

asks: my support left what do I do
supp roamed mid
I'm alone in lane
support's roaming do I stay
say: Alone, farm only what reaches your tower and give the rest, or follow your support if the wave is already pushed in.
more: A roaming support is trying to win somewhere else. Your part is to lose as little as possible here.
One against two you cannot contest the wave in the middle, and they know you are alone.
If the wave is crashed into their tower, going with your support costs nothing and adds a body to the play.
check: Where the wave is, and whether both of them are still in lane.
breaks: If their support roamed too, it is one against one. Play the marksman matchup normally.
basis: pro:The lane without help gives nothing

when: your jungler is dead
asks: my jungler died can I keep pushing
jungler's dead is bot safe
no jungler what do I do
should I back off our jungler died
say: No jungler cover right now, so back off the push and give the far minions, or keep trading only if you saw theirs top.
more: With your jungler dead, their jungler has no one to worry about. A pushed bot lane is the obvious target.
It lasts for one respawn timer. Play small until then.
check: Your jungler's respawn timer, and where their jungler was last seen.
breaks: If their jungler died in the same fight, nothing has changed. Keep playing the lane.
basis: pro:The lane without help gives nothing

when: your team just took or is fighting for an objective on the top side
asks: team's top what do I do bot
they're doing grubs do I stay
everyone's top side
should I play safe while they're top
say: Your team is top side, so hug your tower and give plates rather than fight, or recall if the wave is already lost.
more: When your team plays the other side, the only useful place for their jungler is your lane.
Your job is to give nothing back: no kill, no Flash. A plate is a small price for an objective.
A recall here is efficient. You lose a wave you could not safely take anyway.
check: Whether their jungler showed at the objective, and how many enemies are in your lane.
breaks: If their jungler is visible top side, you are not in danger. Farm normally and even push.
basis: pro:The lane without help gives nothing

when: their bot laners are ahead of you in levels and items
asks: should I defend the tower
tower's almost dead do I stay
do I give tower
they're taking my tower
say: Give the tower rather than die for it; farm at the next one, or defend only if your team is walking down.
more: A tower lost is gold for them. A tower lost with you dead under it is the tower, a kill and the waves that follow.
At the second tower the lane is shorter and safer for you, and they are further from home.
With teammates arriving it becomes a real fight, and their push can turn into kills for you.
check: The tower's health, the size of their wave, and whether anyone from your team is coming.
breaks: If the tower is healthy and the wave is small, it is not falling yet. Clear from behind it.

when: a dragon is up and their bot laners have more kills than yours
asks: they're going dragon do I follow
do we contest drake
should I leave lane for dragon
they rotated to dragon
say: If they pushed first and are already moving, give the dragon and take the wave or plates, or go only with your whole team.
more: A weaker lane arriving second walks into a fight it already lost in lane.
The trade is real: a full wave and tower damage for one early dragon is not a bad exchange.
If your mid and jungler are both there first, it is a different fight and you should join it.
check: Who from your team is at the dragon, and whether your wave is free to push.
breaks: If this dragon would give them soul point, the trade is not worth it. Group early and fight for it.
basis: pro:If you cannot contest, take something elsewhere at once

when: enemies from other lanes have kills, assists or tower damage in bot lane
asks: there's four bot what do I do
their whole team is bot
they're all here
four man bot do I stay
say: Leave the tower and stay alive; four of them take it anyway, or clear waves from the next tower if it's safe.
more: Two cannot hold a tower against four. The only thing you still control is whether they also get kills.
While they are all bot, your team can take something on the other side. Call it.
Waves at your second tower are still yours if you stand far enough back.
check: How many enemies you can see, and whether your team is answering elsewhere.
breaks: If your team has come down in equal numbers, defend with them from behind the tower.
basis: pro:Count what the map pays for a dive or collapse

asks: how do I survive a dive
when do I use my escape
they're diving me what do I press
do I use my shield early
say: Under a dive, hold your escape or block until their key crowd control is thrown, or walk out before the wave arrives.
more: Divers plan around one button. If Spell Shield, Featherstorm, Arcane Shift or Rocket Jump is still available, they have to guess.
Used early, it tells them the rest is free. Used on the stun or the hook, it can turn the dive into kills under your tower.
The safest answer is still not to be there when the wave lands.
check: Which of their abilities starts the dive, and whether your escape is ready.
breaks: If your escape is down, you have no outplay. Leave the tower early.
basis: pro:A dive runs on minions and one defensive button

asks: how do I not get dove
I have no escape
they keep diving me
what do I do with no dash
say: With no dash you can't outplay a dive, so leave before the big wave lands, or stay only with Flash and help nearby.
more: An immobile marksman under tower against three is a kill. The tower does not shoot fast enough to change that.
Leaving one wave early is the cost. Staying is the wave, the death and usually plates as well.
Slows and traps buy a second or two, enough when a teammate is close and not otherwise.
check: Whether Flash is ready, how big the wave is, and whether anyone is coming to help.
breaks: If only their duo is there and you are healthy, it is not a dive yet. Last-hit behind the tower.

when: you carry Heal, Barrier or Cleanse
asks: when do I use heal
should I barrier early
when do I cleanse
do I save my summoner
say: Save it for their second wave of damage, after the crowd control lands, or use it early if it gets you walking out.
more: A defensive spell used at the start of a fight just gets burned through. Used after their big abilities, it outlasts them.
Cleanse is the exception in timing: it goes on the crowd control itself, so you can move again.
Heal also gives a short burst of speed, so it can be the thing that gets you to your tower.
check: Whether the spell is ready, and which of their abilities are still to come.
breaks: If one more hit would kill you, there is no later. Use it now.

when: their bot laners have more kills than yours
asks: they're taking plates should I stop them
do I contest the plates
they keep hitting my tower
how do I stop them taking tower
say: Give a plate rather than trade into a lane that beats you, or clear the wave with abilities from max range to slow them.
more: Plates need minions at the tower. Killing the wave from a distance is the safe way to defend.
Stepping forward to hit champions is what they are waiting for. A plate costs less than a death.
Plates are only up during the lane phase, so every wave you clear safely runs down their time.
check: Your mana for clearing, and whether a third enemy is nearby.
breaks: If a third enemy shows, stop clearing and step back. This has become a dive.

when: their jungler has kills or assists against you or your support
asks: their jungler keeps camping me
I keep getting ganked
he's bot every time
jungler won't leave bot
say: He keeps coming bot, so farm on your half until he shows elsewhere, or ask your team to take the top side meanwhile.
more: A jungler who lives in your lane is not anywhere else. If you give him nothing, his team loses the rest of the map.
That only works if you stop dying. A wave near your tower makes each visit a wasted trip.
Tell your team: with him bot, the top side objectives and camps are open.
check: Where the wave is, and whether the river and tri-brush are warded.
breaks: If he shows on the top side, you have a short window to step up and take the farm you were giving.
basis: pro:If you cannot contest, take something elsewhere at once

asks: jungler's here do we fight
we're getting ganked do I run
three of them do I flash
ganked what do I do
say: Run early toward your tower and keep Flash for the crowd control, or turn only if your jungler is right behind you.
more: The first second decides most ganks. Moving at once often means no summoner is needed at all.
Flash used before the stun gets you stunned on the other side of it. Hold it for the ability that would stop you.
Turning to fight works only with equal numbers, so know where your jungler is before you try.
check: Where your jungler is, and which of their crowd control has been used.
breaks: If you are already cut off from your tower, running that way kills you. Go toward your support or through the river instead.
